description: Grades a public website out of 100 (A–F) across speed & mobile (including Google's live PageSpeed mobile test), Google visibility (SEO), trust & security, and lead capture. Returns every problem ranked by impact with a plain-English fix, what already works, and a link to a shareable full report. Use when the user asks to audit, grade, check, review or analyse a website, its SEO, speed or conversion. Takes 10–40 seconds.
